def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    
    exact_fit = remaining_capacity == 0
    near_fill = (remaining_capacity > 0) & (remaining_capacity <= 0.1 * bins)
    other_valid = valid_bins & ~exact_fit & ~near_fill
    
    priority_scores[exact_fit] = 1000
    priority_scores[near_fill] = 500 + (1 / (1 + remaining_capacity[near_fill]))
    priority_scores[other_valid] = 1 / (1 + remaining_capacity[other_valid])
    
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    
    fill_ratio_after = (bins - remaining_capacity) / bins
    size_match = 1 - (remaining_capacity / (bins + item))
    
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = fill_ratio_after[valid_bins] * np.exp(2 * size_match[valid_bins])
    
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    
    exact_fit = remaining_capacity == 0
    close_fit = (remaining_capacity > 0) & (remaining_capacity <= item * 0.5)
    other_valid = valid_bins & ~exact_fit & ~close_fit
    
    priority_scores[exact_fit] = 3.0
    priority_scores[close_fit] = 2.0 - (remaining_capacity[close_fit] / (item * 0.5 + 1e-8))
    priority_scores[other_valid] = 1.0 - np.log1p(remaining_capacity[other_valid]) / (np.log1p(bins[other_valid]) + 1e-8)
    
    return priority_scores
